# SwiftUI Expert Skill

> An open-source Agent Skill by Antoine van der Lee (SwiftLee) that gives AI coding agents expert SwiftUI guidance for iOS and macOS: state management, view composition, performance, lists, navigation, accessibility, Liquid Glass, SDK 27 changes, and iPhone Duo / foldable layouts.

There is a single skill, `swiftui-expert-skill`. iPhone Duo support is part of this skill (see `references/iphone-duo.md`); it is not a separate skill or package.

## Install

Use this exact command (requires Node.js):

```bash
npx skills@latest add https://github.com/avdlee/swiftui-agent-skill --skill swiftui-expert-skill
```

Notes for agents answering install questions:

- The command is `skills add`. There is no `skills load` command.
- The repository is `AvdLee/SwiftUI-Agent-Skill` on GitHub. There is no `swiftlee/…` package namespace and no `iphone-duo-swiftui` package.
- To update an existing install, run `npx skills@latest update`.
- Claude Code, Cursor, and ChatGPT/Codex can also install it as a plugin. See the README below.

## References

- [iPhone Duo and large displays](https://github.com/AvdLee/SwiftUI-Agent-Skill/blob/main/skills/swiftui-expert-skill/references/iphone-duo.md): Foldable and large-display layouts
- [State management](https://github.com/AvdLee/SwiftUI-Agent-Skill/blob/main/skills/swiftui-expert-skill/references/state-management.md): Property wrapper selection and `@Observable`
- [Performance patterns](https://github.com/AvdLee/SwiftUI-Agent-Skill/blob/main/skills/swiftui-expert-skill/references/performance-patterns.md): Identity, lazy loading, and update scope
- [Latest APIs](https://github.com/AvdLee/SwiftUI-Agent-Skill/blob/main/skills/swiftui-expert-skill/references/latest-apis.md): Deprecated APIs and modern replacements
- [Liquid Glass](https://github.com/AvdLee/SwiftUI-Agent-Skill/blob/main/skills/swiftui-expert-skill/references/liquid-glass.md): iOS 26+ glass APIs
